text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it, look at this pathetic state.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic...
But the facts are the facts.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...A long time ago, a dojo master who used to buy sake from my family's shop said something."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "There are mysterious victories, but never mysterious defeats."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I believe you're right.
This defeat, too... was brought about by my own inadequacy."
choice_data_list: Don't beat yourself up over it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I believe you're right.
This defeat, too... was brought about by my own inadequacy."
choice_data_list: Don't beat yourself up over it.

text_block_list.text:
Poor mental well-being hinders training.
So, I told her not to brood over things too much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, so that's it.
In that case, there is nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm not as fragile as you think.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I just don't want
to forget the taste of this bitterness."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll train thoroughly,
even harder than before.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"The strong ones won't wait for me...
They're going to keep pulling further and further ahead."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I have to overtake it.
Even if it's a thorny path, I'm ready for it."
